'''Chief Military Advisor''' was a position held by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He served as [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma's]] personal Chief Military Advisor to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Advisory Council (Alliance)|Advisory Council]].
